outcomes.outcome: the shared script that applies the settings is installed root-owned and executable
an agent run while the user is logged out changes nothing and leaves a note
with the user logged in, the user's kscreenlockerrc gets Autolock and LockOnResume on, the timeout and the grace, reloaded live
the idle session locks after the class's timeout (without the class's settings it was not locked 450 s after login)
a user who turns the lock off in the live session gets it back on the next agent run, and the session locks
the grace period (0 seconds) takes effect, so input right after the lock does not unlock without a password
